GET /accounts/{account_id}/d1/insights/d.description:
List the databases in your account with the highest usage in a time window, sorted by `order_by`
from highest to lowest.

Totals are computed from the same data as D1 billing and the GraphQL Analytics API. They include
every batch in the window: queries, imports and exports, successful and failed. Totals from other
insights endpoints that read per-statement data can be lower than these numbers.

Deleted databases are included if they had usage in the window. Databases with no usage in the
window are not included.

Usage is available a few minutes after a batch completes.

For more complex filtering, or other metrics, groupings or time windows, run your own SQL on the
`events.d1Queries` dataset with `cf sql query`. For examples, see https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/observability/find-expensive-queries/

schema.description: The usage metric to sort by, from highest to lowest.
Only count usage from databases whose name contains this value, case-insensitive. Usage recorded before 2026-10-30 has no database name and is not matched.
If true, `database_name` must match the full database name, case-sensitive.
Start of the window (inclusive), in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to 24 hours before `until`. Must be before `until`, and at most 90 days ago. The window from `since` to `until` must be at most 31 days.
End of the window (exclusive), in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to the current time.
Maximum number of databases to return. Results are not paginated, so only the top `limit` databases are returned.

200.description: List D1 databases by usage response

success.description: Whether the API call was successful

database_name.description: The database name recorded with its usage in the window. Null when no usage in the window recorded a name, for example usage before 2026-10-30.

queries.description: Number of queries (read and write) in the window.

rows_read.description: Number of rows read in the window.

rows_written.description: Number of rows written in the window.

order_by.description: The usage metric the results are sorted by.

query_window.description: The resolved window, in UTC. `from` is inclusive, `to` is exclusive.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/d1/insights/q.description:
List the SQL statements with the highest usage in a time window, across all databases in your
account or for one database, sorted by `order_by` from highest to lowest.

Each item is one query text in one database. The same text run in two databases is two items.

Values are estimates computed from sampled per-statement data. They include statements that
failed with a SQL error, and deleted databases. They do not include imports and exports, so they
can be lower than the totals from `GET /accounts/{account_id}/d1/insights/databases`, billing, and
the GraphQL Analytics API.

Usage is available a few minutes after a query completes.

For more complex filtering, or other metrics, groupings or time windows, run your own SQL on the
`events.d1Queries` dataset with `cf sql query`. For examples, see https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/observability/find-expensive-queries/

schema.description: The usage metric to sort by, from highest to lowest. `duration` sorts by `total_duration_ms`.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/.description:
Restore a deleted D1 database. The database is restored with the name it had when it was deleted,
unless `new_name` is provided. The restored database counts against the account's limits.
Undeleting a database that is not deleted succeeds without changes, unless `new_name` differs from its current name which errors.
A database can only be undeleted within 7 days (7 * 24 hours) of its deletion.

Once a database is undeleted, Time Travel (point-in-time recovery) cannot restore it to a bookmark or
timestamp at or before the undeletion. Only states after the undeletion can be restored.
